lines.text:
You hoping to make it to the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Pokémon League[VAR COLOR(0000)]
someday, too?\c
That’s where you can battle the strongest
of all Pokémon Trainers...
The ones they call the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Elite Four[VAR COLOR(0000)]!
I was hoping maybe I could get a glimpse of ’em,\nbut the guard at the gate wouldn’t even let me\r\npass without any Badges from Pokémon Gyms!

Guess I’ll just have to get there the long way:
by battling and getting strong!\c
So, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]!
I guess that means it’s on!

[VAR RIVALNAME(0001)]: Hmm...
Maybe battling like this is just helping you get
stronger, huh, [VAR TRNAME(0000)]?\c
Oh well! That works, too!
Let’s train hard so that someday we both make\nit to the Pokémon League!
